== Summary ==
[[Brad DeFruiter]], former Decipher ''[[Star Trek CCG]]'' designer. His own profile photograph on a public social-media profile under the name "Brad DeFruiter". Converted from WebP to JPEG, otherwise unchanged.

* '''Source:''' [https://bsky.app/profile/plainbrad.bsky.social Brad DeFruiter (@plainbrad.bsky.social)], Bluesky profile, read 27 October 2026. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202550/https://bsky.app/profile/plainbrad.bsky.social Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202554id_/https://cdn.bsky.app/img/avatar/plain/did:plc:msmxfseergzkosrlbqfd65xb/bafkreidmzdu7m5hsgnjtmyjl3l3dd6sch2jjypanrns44hqu22on73ht24 profile photo] (Wayback SHA-1 matches the WebP original).
* '''Photographer:''' self-portrait (profile photo chosen by the account holder).
* '''Date:''' unknown; read 27 October 2026.
* '''Identification:''' Small World Rule. DeFruiter is a rare surname, and the account is followed by former Decipher designer [[Chuck Kallenbach]] (follower list: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027203059/https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/app.bsky.graph.getFollowers?actor=plainbrad.bsky.social&limit=100 preserved copy]). Reasoning on [[Talk:Brad DeFruiter]].

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a profile photograph, used only to identify a former Decipher game designer on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. No free photograph of him is known, and this use cannot harm any market for the original.
